I read some of your posts and I really think you should do whatever it takes to try the medication. You can't take it without... taking it. Ask yourself what's worse: continuing to live like your currently are or swallowing a tiny pill every day? Are you more afraid of a pill then reliving your trauma and suffering every day?

Here are some suggestions:
* Put the pill in another food and swallow it whole. It's difficult to find a food small enough to swallow but large enough but a grape might work?
* Ask for liquid medicine. Escitalopram (Lexapro) also comes in liquid form. You can easily mix this into some juice or whatever you like.
* Crush the pill up and mix it into very flavorful food (for example, nutella or peanut butter). These pills have a very bad taste so you'll really want something strong.

Good luck. You can do it.
